title: The charged and proven cases on this site, as the District Attorney's files record them
question: What do the District Attorney's three public files say about the court numbers the case files already cite?
finding: Two of the thirteen court numbers are resolved, both as convictions: 22001657 (filed 18 Feb 2022, resolved 29 Sep 2023, 588 days) and 24004990 (filed 21 Mar 2024, State prison sentence 5 Jan 2026, 655 days). Four are pending in the prosecuted file (25028484, 25028488, 26004009, 26007118). 23013637 is listed as a new filing with 23 Government Code 1090 counts and no status. 23013720, 24001435, 25025111 and 26007115 are in neither the prosecuted nor the resolutions file; nor are 25023975 and 25024194, the alternate numbers the court lists for the 2023 co-defendants, which the arrests file marks "Discharged" on arrest dates two weeks before the 18 November 2025 indictment. For 26007118 the prosecuted file lists only three perjury counts (118(a)); the arrests file listed 424(a)(1) and three 118(a).
how: Each court number the case files cite was looked up in the arrests file (czsm-3ei3, data as of 9 Nov 2026), the cases-prosecuted file (dcjk-vw8q) and the resolutions file (ynfy-z5kt), both as of 23 Nov 2026. Charges are tallied as listed.
limits: The files carry no names; the link from court number to person comes from the court records and District Attorney releases the cases already cite. A grand-jury indictment (25025111) and a case filed without an arrest record may never enter these files, and a court number missing from them is not a dismissal. A status in these files is the District Attorney's system, not the court's register.
